        ### Question
        Which of the following manifestations is LESS likely in tubulo-interstitial nephritis ?:

        ### Options

opb. Nephrogenic diabetes insipidus.
opc. Progressive renal failure.
opd. Renal tubular acidosis.

CHAIN: Tubulo-interstitial nephritis -> tubular damage -> impaired reabsorption of proteins -> less likely to have proteinuria greater than 3.5 g in 24 hours -> 90%
CHAIN: Tubulo-interstitial nephritis -> chronic inflammation -> progressive renal damage -> more likely to have progressive renal failure -> less likely to have renal tubular acidosis -> 85%
